claims.text: This excerpt shows various system events and conditions on the authorMacBook-Pro, including thermal and memory pressure states, IPv6 address assignments, and Thunderbolt HPD packet notifications.
It also indicates that the system woke up and that there were denied network-outbound attempts by the com.apple.Addres process.
The events are logged by different system components, such as the kernel, com.apple.CDScheduler, and sandboxd, over a period of approximately 35 minutes.
